programs.title: Dual Survival 2
programs.desc: Former soldier Dave Canterbury and naturalist Cody Lundin set off to dangerous corners of the world to prove that humans can survive in any conditions.They present survival techniques and teach creative thinking.In the second season of the series, Canterbury and Lundin will often get into trouble.They become known as lost tourists, divers trapped underwater, shipwrecked at sea, and alpinists isolated in the mountains.Equipped with basic equipment, they will be forced to use survival school techniques to stay alive.
